name: Melrisia Migung
source:
Belotd Pireche, a life sentence prisoner living in a special criminal detention center, receives a strange note one day.
a list of unknown alphabets What does this memo mean?
The strange thing happened when I lived in the camp for a month.
Belod, a life sentence prisoner, will be decided to leave the camp with death row James Beek and surviving killer Wedna Andrew, and will instead be transferred to Lavirintos, a prison that "can never come out again once you enter."
One month is left before he is transferred to Lavirintos, which is practically hellish. Belod goes through strange things and realizes that where he is is not the real world but the labyrinth.
The only clue to get out of the labyrinth is a note that doesn't know the meaning. What does this memo mean?
translation:
生活在特殊刑事拘留中心的无期徒刑囚犯贝洛特·皮雷切（Belotd Pireche）有一天收到一张奇怪的字条。
未知字母列表 这个备忘录是什么意思？
当我在营地住了一个月后，奇怪的事情发生了。
贝洛德是一名无期徒刑囚犯，他将被决定与死囚詹姆斯·比克和幸存的杀手韦德娜·安德鲁一起离开集中营，转而被转移到拉维林托斯，这是一座“一旦进入就再也出不来”的监狱。
距离他被转移到几乎地狱般的拉维林托斯还有一个月的时间。贝洛德经历了奇怪的事情，意识到自己所在的地方不是现实世界，而是迷宫。
走出迷宫的唯一线索是一张不知道含义的纸条。这份备忘录是什么意思？
